summary: Covers hash (sha1, md5, others), checksum, and password_hash (sha512/sha256, custom salt, idempotent seeded salt, rounds). hash depends on hashlib and password_hash on passlib, with crypt as fallback, so results differ depending on passlib.
questions: How do I generate a SHA-512 password hash for the user module?
How do I get the md5 or sha1 of a string in Ansible?
How do I make password_hash idempotent across runs?
Why does password_hash give different results on different control nodes?

answer_card.title: Hashing strings and passwords
